title.zh: 一个反应会不会发生、能走多远，是谁说了算 · 一篇可以动手的长文
title.en: What Decides Whether a Reaction Goes and How Far It Gets · Interactive Essay

desc.zh: 从数微观排法、玻尔兹曼因子和 ΔG = ΔH − TΔS 出发，一路推到平衡常数、催化剂、埃林厄姆图、哈伯合成氨和相分离，再看 2026 年绿色合成氨、电解水与直接空气捕碳的前沿：每一步都有真实方程搭的模型。
desc.en: From counting microstates, the Boltzmann factor, and ΔG = ΔH − TΔS to equilibrium constants, catalysts, Ellingham diagrams, Haber–Bosch ammonia synthesis, phase separation, and 2026 electrolysis and direct air capture benchmarks, backed by equation-driven interactive models.

title.zh: 微观排法数与玻尔兹曼熵 S = k_B ln W

desc.zh: 孤立系统的走向由总微观排法数 W 决定，如冷敷袋硝酸铵吸热溶解与无相互作用气体混合。
desc.en: Isolated systems evolve toward overwhelming microstate multiplicity W, explaining endothermic cold-pack dissolution and entropy-driven mixing.

zh: 吸热反应为什么还能自发
冷敷袋为什么自己变冷还化开
微观状态数 W
玻尔兹曼熵公式
en: why endothermic reactions happen

microstate multiplicity
Boltzmann entropy S = kB ln W

title.zh: 玻尔兹曼因子与热浴借能代价
title.en: Boltzmann Factor and Borrowing Energy from a Thermal Bath

desc.zh: 小系统从恒温热浴借走能量 E_i 会使热浴排法数按 exp(−E_i/RT) 指数下降。
desc.en: Borrowing energy E_i from a constant-temperature bath reduces bath multiplicity by exp(−E_i/RT), giving the Boltzmann distribution.

zh: 为什么高能态分子那么少

有限热浴精确计数
en: where the Boltzmann factor comes from
exp(-E/RT)

title.zh: 吉布斯自由能 ΔG = ΔH − TΔS 与四象限地图
title.en: Gibbs Free Energy and the Four-Quadrant Reaction Map

desc.zh: 恒温恒压下 ΔG = −T·ΔS_总，用 ΔH 与 ΔS 正负号及翻转温度 T* = ΔH/ΔS 划分反应方向。
desc.en: At constant T and p, ΔG = −T·ΔS_total packs environmental entropy into a single ledger whose four quadrants govern temperature-driven direction flips.

zh: ΔG = ΔH - TΔS 是什么意思

en: what does ΔG = ΔH - TΔS mean
why limestone kilns need high temperature
reaction crossover temperature
four quadrants of ΔH and ΔS

title.zh: 自由能曲线谷底、平衡常数 K 与范特霍夫方程
title.en: Minimum of G(ξ), Equilibrium Constant K, and Van 't Hoff

desc.zh: 混合熵把 G(ξ) 在 0 与 1 之间拽出最低点，使 ΔG° > 0 也能部分转化；压强只改 Q 不改 K，温度通过范特霍夫方程改变 K。
desc.en: Entropy of mixing pulls G(ξ) to an interior minimum where ΔrG = ΔG° + RT ln Q = 0; pressure shifts Q while temperature shifts K via Van 't Hoff.

zh: 为什么反应不能进行到百分之百
ΔG° 为正为什么反应还能发生一点
勒夏特列原理本质
范特霍夫方程怎么看
en: why reactions do not go to 100%
why positive ΔG° still reaches partial equilibrium
Le Chatelier principle mathematically
Van 't Hoff equation ln K vs 1/T

title.zh: 活化能、过渡态与催化剂不改平衡终点
title.en: Activation Barriers, Transition States, and Catalyst Equilibrium Invariance

desc.zh: k_正/k_逆 = K 使催化剂只能等量削低正逆能垒、指数加速达平衡，而无法移动平衡占比。
desc.en: Microscopic reversibility k_f/k_r = K forces catalysts to lower forward and reverse barriers equally, speeding approach without shifting equilibrium yield.

zh: 催化剂能提高平衡转化率吗

title.zh: 反应耦合、ATP 水解、ΔG = −nFE 与埃林厄姆图
title.en: Reaction Coupling, ATP Hydrolysis, ΔG = −nFE, and the Ellingham Diagram

desc.zh: 通过化学反应耦合或外加电功驱动逆风反应；2C + O₂ → 2CO 的负斜率解释为什么碳能炼铁炼锌却炼不出铝。
desc.en: Driving ΔG > 0 steps by coupling to ATP hydrolysis, electricity (ΔG = −nFE), or coke oxidation whose negative Ellingham slope smelts Fe and Zn but not Al.

zh: 为什么碳能炼铁却炼不出铝

title.zh: 哈伯–博施合成氨的热力学–动力学妥协窗口
title.en: Haber–Bosch Ammonia Synthesis Window and Industrial Compromise

desc.zh: 低温平衡高但速率冻结、高温速率快但平衡塌陷，工业不得不在 400–500 °C、150–300 bar 下靠单程 10–20% 配冷凝循环榨干收率。
desc.en: Using Gillespie–Beattie equilibrium and iron-catalyst Arrhenius kinetics, industrial ammonia plants compromise at 400–500 °C and 150–300 bar with recycle loops.

zh: 合成氨为什么既要高温又要高压

en: why Haber-Bosch runs at 450 C and 200 bar

title.zh: 正规溶液、共切线与双节线/旋节线相分离
title.en: Regular Solution, Common Tangent, Binodal and Spinodal Phase Separation

desc.zh: 当排斥能 Ω 超过热能（T < T_c），自由能曲线出现双谷，系统按共切线拆成两相；旋节线内无需形核能垒直接分相。
desc.en: When interaction energy Ω exceeds thermal mixing below T_c, common-tangent phase splitting lowers total free energy along binodal and spinodal boundaries.

desc.en: Benchmarking 2026 green hydrogen electrolysis, direct air capture, ambient Li-mediated NH3, and CO2-to-ethylene against irreversible thermodynamic floors.
